newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK seven-year notes avg accepted yield 6.66 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK seven-year notes avg accepted yield 6.66 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the average accepted price of the seven-year Exchange Fund notes tendered today was 99.48 yielding 6.66 percent versus 6.91 percent at a previous tender in November.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue totalled HK$3.98 billion, down from HK$4.65 billion at the last tender.
The lowest price accepted was 99.48, while the average tendered price was 99.43 yielding 6.67 percent, it said.
The notes carry a coupon of 6.46 percent and mature on February 25, 2004.
